description: Save a recipe to the workspace's library. The recipe is checked and clamped to the recipe format; a v1 or a v2 recipe is accepted and comes back as schema 2. Without id it becomes a new recipe at version 1; with the id of one of the workspace's recipes it becomes that recipe's next version (older versions stay). use_for_series adds it to that series' styles; make_default makes it the default recipe of those accounts. To change a few settings of a saved recipe, recipe_update is easier. Call recipe_schema first: it lists every setting with its path, limits, choices and whether the phone draws it yet.

id.description: Save a new version of this recipe

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

make_default.description: Make this recipe the default for these accounts

series_of_post.description: Use the recipe for the series this post belongs to (the phone sends the post it is editing)

use_for_series.description: A series id to use the recipe for

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_save
title: Save a recipe
